title: Supplemental Japanese verb peer follow-up public development bank

sample_reference.role: Pinned fixed sample key/gloss reference used to select these follow-up vocabulary groups; sample rows are not reproduced here.

provenance.sentence_provenance: All Japanese sentences were written for this draft. No dictionary examples, corpora, or external sentence text were copied.
provenance.reference_provenance: Taiwan Traditional Chinese references were written independently for this draft and remain provisional pending review.

purpose: Provide public development context contrasts for eight fixed peer keys and explicit negative controls for related but distinct verb constructions. These rows are follow-up coverage, not a verdict on the fixed sample.
level_note: Approximate sentence difficulty only. This is not a JLPT exam or certification. Some vocabulary may be above N5.

review_and_adoption.process: Independent language review and adoption must be recorded in a separate data-only PR before any rule uses these rows for acceptance.
review_and_adoption.scope_limit: These rows sample only the listed contextual distinctions and controls. They do not decide the fixed 100-row sample or define every sense of these verbs.

items.jp: 私は図書館から学校へ帰った。
items.zh_hant: 我從圖書館回到學校。
semantic_checks: から marks the starting point and 学校へ names a non-home return destination.
The Japanese source explicitly supports the return to nonhome reading.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not state why the speaker returns or how they travel.

control.source_cue: から marks the starting point and 学校へ names a non-home return destination.
stable: The Japanese and Taiwan Traditional Chinese sentences are original first-party development material.
changed: This row checks return to nonhome for 帰る.
limits: The source does not state why the speaker returns or how they travel.
